description_en: Upgrades the kernel version of a PolarDB for MySQL cluster
description_zh: 升级PolarDB MySQL版集群的内核版本
name: UpgradeDBClusterVersion

parameters.help_en:
The cluster ID.
You can call the https://help.aliyun.com/document_detail/98094.html operation to query the details of all clusters under your account, such as the cluster ID
parameters.help_zh:
集群ID。
您可以通过https://help.aliyun.com/document_detail/98094.html接口查看账号下所有集群的详细信息（如集群ID）
parameters.name: db_cluster_id

parameters.help_en:
The kernel version upgrade policy. Valid values:

HOT: hot upgrade

COLD: cold upgrade. Currently, only PolarDB for MySQL 8.0 Cluster Edition supports this upgrade method
parameters.help_zh:
内核版本升级策略。取值范围如下：

HOT：热升级

COLD：冷升级。目前仅PolarDB MySQL版8.0集群版支持该升级方式
parameters.name: upgrade_policy

parameters.help_en:
The kernel version upgrade label. Set the value to INNOVATE.

This parameter applies only to upgrades from PolarDB for MySQL 8.0.1 to PolarDB for MySQL 8.0.2.
If you specify this parameter, you must set `UpgradePolicy` to COLD
parameters.help_zh:
内核版本升级标签。取值固定为INNOVATE。

该参数仅适用于PolarDB MySQL版8.0.1版本升级至PolarDB MySQL版8.0.2版本。
当传入该参数时，`UpgradePolicy`必须传入COLD
parameters.name: upgrade_label

parameters.help_en:
The earliest time to start the scheduled Milvus version upgrade task. The time must be in the `YYYY-MM-DDThh:mm:ssZ` format (UTC).
The start time can be any time within the next 72 hours. For example, if the current time is `2021-01-14T09:00:00Z`, the allowed start time ranges from `2021-01-14T09:00:00Z` to `2021-01-17T09:00:00Z`.
If this parameter is left empty, the Milvus version upgrade task is executed immediately by default
parameters.help_zh:
开始执行定时（即在目标时间段内执行）内核版本升级任务的最早时间。格式为`YYYY-MM-DDThh:mm:ssZ`（UTC）。
开始时间的取值范围为未来72小时内的任意时间点。例如当前时间为`2021-01-14T09:00:00Z`，此处允许填入的开始时间范围为`2021-01-14T09:00:00Z`~`2021-01-17T09:00:00Z`。
若该参数留空，默认立即执行内核版本升级任务
parameters.name: planned_start_time

parameters.help_en:
The latest time to start the scheduled task. The time must be in the `YYYY-MM-DDThh:mm:ssZ` format (UTC).
The latest time must be at least 30 minutes later than the start time.
If PlannedStartTime is specified but this parameter is not, the latest time to start the task defaults to the start time plus 30 minutes. For example, if PlannedStartTime is set to `2021-01-14T09:00:00Z` and this parameter is left empty, the task will start at `2021-01-14T09:30:00Z` at the latest
parameters.help_zh:
开始执行目标定时任务的最晚时间。格式为`YYYY-MM-DDThh:mm:ssZ`（UTC）。
最晚时间需晚于开始时间的30分钟或以上。
若设置了`PlannedStartTime`但未指定该参数，执行目标任务的最晚时间默认为`开始时间+30分钟`。例如当设置`PlannedStartTime`为`2021-01-14T09:00:00Z`且该参数留空时，目标任务最晚将于`2021-01-14T09:30:00Z`开始执行
parameters.name: planned_end_time

parameters.help_en:
Specifies whether to execute the kernel version upgrade immediately or on a schedule. Valid values:

false (default): scheduled execution

true: immediate execution

You do not need to specify this parameter when you call this operation
parameters.help_zh:
立即执行或定时执行内核版本升级。取值范围如下：

false（默认值）：定时执行

true：立即执行

调用该接口时无需使用该参数
parameters.name: from_time_service

parameters.help_en:
The upgrade type. Valid values:

PROXY: upgrades only PolarProxy.

DB: upgrades only the database engine.

ALL (default): upgrades both PolarProxy and the database engine
parameters.help_zh:
升级类型。取值范围如下：

PROXY：仅升级数据库代理（Proxy）

DB：仅升级内核引擎

ALL（默认值）：同时升级数据库代理（Proxy）和内核引擎
parameters.name: upgrade_type

parameters.help_en: The VersionCode of the target database engine version. You can obtain the value by calling the https://help.aliyun.com/document_detail/2319145.html operation
parameters.help_zh: DB目标版本的VersionCode，参数取值可从https://help.aliyun.com/document_detail/2319145.html接口获取
parameters.name: target_db_revision_version_code

parameters.help_en: The VersionCode of the target PolarProxy version. You can obtain the value by calling the https://help.aliyun.com/document_detail/2319145.html operation
parameters.help_zh: Proxy目标版本的VersionCode，参数取值可从https://help.aliyun.com/document_detail/2319145.html接口获取
parameters.name: target_proxy_revision_version_code
